content: isn't ob nixilis really good in this deck?

Yes—if you mean Ob Nixilis, the Hate-Twisted, he’s another Nekusar-style payoff: each opponent’s draw costs them 1 life, and his −2 can destroy a creature while forcing its controller to draw two cards. The trade-off is spending five mana on a planeswalker that’s vulnerable to attacks. If you mean Ob Nixilis, Captive Kingpin, he also works well with Nekusar’s individual 1-damage triggers, generating +1/+1 counters and cards you can play from exile—which one did you mean?

Yes—both fit Nekusar’s color identity and your bracket without adding another Game Changer. The Hate-Twisted adds draw punishment and creature removal, while Captive Kingpin turns Nekusar’s individual damage triggers into growth and playable exiled cards. Cutting two slower artifacts keeps the deck at 100, though you lose some lifegain.
